days.file: Jean-François Millet - The Angelus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Angelus
days.alt: At dusk in a wide field, a farmer and his wife stand with heads bowed in prayer, a fork and a basket at their feet.
days.look: Look again at the two workers, heads bowed, their tools set down. What would you lay down before Christ today?
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: A Vaccaro Desinterés de San Cayetano Lienzo. 123 x 76 cm. Museo del Prado.jpg
days.title: Saint Cajetan Refuses Offerings
days.alt: A priest in black raises his hands to refuse a platter of coins that a nobleman in a red cloak offers, while a page holds the platter.
days.look: Look again at the saint’s open hands, turning the coins away. Where are you tempted to trust your own effort more than God’s care?
days.license: Artist died 1670; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Annibale Carracci, Cristo e la Cananea, 1595, Parma.jpg
days.title: Christ and the Canaanite Woman
days.alt: A woman kneels and reaches toward Christ, who turns to her with his hand outstretched.
days.look: Look again at the woman’s reaching hand and her eyes on Christ. What is the one thing you most want to ask?
days.license: Artist died 1609; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Joseph in His Workshop (Mérode Altarpiece)
days.place: The Cloisters, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: Joseph, in a red robe and blue cap, sits in his workshop and bores a hole in a board with a hand drill.
days.look: Look again at Joseph’s hands at their quiet task. How might your own work be a way of caring for what God has given?
days.license: Artist died 1444; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Giovanni Battista Moroni - The Tailor ('Il Tagliapanni') - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Tailor (Il Tagliapanni)
days.alt: A tailor in a pale doublet stands at his cutting table with shears resting on a length of dark cloth.
days.look: Look again at the tailor’s steady hands and the cloth before him. What skill has God put in your hands?
days.license: Artist died 1578; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Pieter de Hooch (1629 - in oder nach 1679) - Woman weighing Gold - 1401B - Gemäldegalerie.jpg
days.title: Woman Weighing Gold
days.alt: A woman in a blue jacket and grey head covering stands by a window and holds a small balance over a box of coins.
days.look: Look again at the woman holding the balance, her eyes on the scale. Where in your work would you want your scales to be just?
days.license: Artist died 1684; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Giotto di Bondone - No. 20 Scenes from the Life of Christ - 4. Flight into Egypt - WGA09198.jpg
days.title: The Flight into Egypt
days.alt: Joseph walks beside a donkey carrying Mary and the swaddled child, a small angel in the sky above them.
days.look: Look again at Joseph, walking beside the donkey. When a decision is hard, whose guidance are you waiting for?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Widow's Mite (Le denier de la veuve) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: The Widow's Mite
days.alt: A widow in a grey robe and pale veil, carrying a small child, walks out of the temple courtyard past seated onlookers.
days.look: Look again at the widow walking away with her child, having given all she had. What could you share, even when little is left?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jean Siméon Chardin - The Prayer before Meal - WGA04768.jpg
days.title: The Prayer Before the Meal
days.alt: A mother sets the table while the small child before her folds its hands to say grace.
days.look: Look again at the little one’s folded hands before the meal. What is one thing you can thank God for tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1779; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
